scheduling_rules: Priority waves guide scheduling, not new all-or-nothing gates. Within allowed scope continue ready independent work when another item is externally blocked.

Original depends_on is retained for acceptance lineage. Software-only provenance/identity work can start against available allowed modules before native predecessors finish; that does not satisfy native acceptance.
First accepted installed positive chain is a high priority result. Existing initialize/list and attach-only error prove only their own scope.
Freeze a stable product candidate for actual tests. Reuse unaffected accepted evidence. Do not continuously rebuild all packages for documentary changes.

Explicitly refused commands/outcomes/resources remain fenced; do not retry, rename, delegate or recreate the same refused outcome. Check genuine later matching authorization before any otherwise-blocked action.

Final completion requires all applicable U criteria, three active native targets and real independent reviewer acceptance. If only external blockers remain, report implemented scope plus blockers, never universal completion.
Inspect current environment/authorization only within its actual scope. Never rerun a specifically refused outcome by renaming, alternative entrypoint or delegation.
Parent historical DONE statuses are retained; required new-candidate refinements are separate. No bulk reset and no blanket historical PASS inheritance.
After a child verifies the required software portion, the parent may be marked implementation_done=true with evidence while its native obligations remain open. No automatic roll-up.
Maintain one compact working progress ledger. Refer to immutable history instead of appending duplicate receipts for each read, hash or formatting change.

When a native target is unavailable, prepare or execute independent tasks and other targets. Only after no authorized required action remains may the run pause as WAITING_EXTERNAL with precise unblock conditions.
Cold start is a one-time environment/source check, not a reset of historical T01.a/T03.a or a new product requirement.

The old conversation has been deleted. Do not wait for its future messages or reuse inherited process/session handles. Inspect only current observable source/recovery facts within authorization; keep old UNKNOWN resources isolated.

If a verified existing checkout is usable, continue there without overwriting modifications; otherwise recover the fixed source to an independent new directory. Do not overwrite the old recovery stage or terminate unknown processes.

The raw latest state is preserved exactly for status/implementation_done/execution_complete. Current documentary evidence and new controls may narrow claims but do not silently erase or upgrade history.

R22 is an older interim offline artifact, not the current source qualification. Rebuild only a coherent necessary candidate for the next real flow, not a new three-platform bundle after every independent small patch.

Preparation scopes in selected tasks permit bounded read-only or isolated software work before integration dependencies finish; they cannot satisfy completion gates, run frozen actions, or authorize native execution.
